## Integrity Intake
Validate the WF-011 contract and normalize optional knowledge input.

## Persistence Verification
Verify required files, declared summary counts, and every file result.

## Knowledge Integrity Checks
Deterministic identifiers, duplicates, references, timeline, and conflicts.

## Scoring
Apply severity penalties and derive readiness.

## Output
Build one integrity report and the WF-013 contract.
